notes.title: Early Access 1.16.1 - Bug Fixes and Optimisations
notes.notes:
This update fixes a lot of bugs, thank you for your feedback alerting us to them. We've also updated our pathfinding system to support multiple AIs - soon we will start adding new enemies and wildlife!

We're aware of an issue where the airship can get caught in the terrain. If this happens to you please submit a feedback, we've added some extra information to the logging to help us resolve it.

[h3]Patch Notes[/h3]
[list][*] Optimised seeker spawn stutter
[*] Optimised location loading stutter
[*] Autosave now occurs when you land rather than when you get near a location
[*] The "recover your items" message after dying now specifies your coffin's location
[*] Coffins now disappear after being emptied
[*] Hopefully fixed issue with disappearing terrain
[*] Fixed crafted nail/screw boxes only giving 1 nail/screw (now 5)
[*] Fixed crafted bullet boxes only giving 1 bullet (now 6)
[*] Fixed issue where you wouldn't respawn after dying and could access inventory but not move or do anything else.
[*] Fixed fortune teller wobblehead not appearing in inventory when picked up
[*] Fixed not being able to pick up food tin in Badlands iron cave
[*] Fixed error if you looked at the burner while trying to build another apparatus
[*] Fixed loading error if a coffin was saved and loaded twice
[*] Fixed error where a coffin on the airship would appear floating in the air
[*] Fixed error where a coffin or item on the airship wouldn't stick to the airship after save and load
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access Update 1.16 - New Open World
notes.notes:
[h2]New Open World[/h2]
Desert Skies now has a fixed open world map instead of one that is procedurally generated as you fly. This makes exploring the deserts a more engaging experience which will keep getting better as we fill the world with lots of details to find and explore. Press M to view the in-game map to help you navigate the world as you search for locations, caves and resources.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34741963/6826ae05f6b8c36a3438d76a0ffffdb41e3d1069.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34741963/6826ae05f6b8c36a3438d76a0ffffdb41e3d1069.png[/img][/url]

The current version of the world is just the beginning. It was mostly created using our old procedural generation tools with a bit of manual editing. Now that it's fully operational we will be working on new world creation tools to empower us to hand-craft lots of interesting areas to find and explore in the deserts. As we improve the world over coming updates borders will shift, biomes will become unique, and the landscape will grow with hills, valleys, canyons, roads/rails and more.

[h2]New UI[/h2]
We now have artwork for our menus, in-game HUD and interfaces!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34741963/d23eba9af450b39d0296ece3aabfc5c46ecb9438.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34741963/d23eba9af450b39d0296ece3aabfc5c46ecb9438.png[/img][/url]

The build menu will also be updated after we make some gameplay changes to how you find and learn schematics to build.

[h2]Inventory System[/h2]
Our old inventory system could not work with multiplayer, so we rebuilt it. The new system is multiplayer ready and has improved features - you can split item stacks, it will remember which slot you like to keep each tool and consumable in, and it intelligently picks which stacks to add items to and remove from.

[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] The wind can now blow in any direction instead of always pointing westerly. We have improved how the wind and engine interact so that it's easier to fly the direction you want even when it's against the wind.
[*] White Sands is now a biome of towering dunes interspersed with fields of bright red flowers, while Salt Flats is now very flat. These are the first steps in these biomes' development, with more to come as we improve our world building tools.
[*] We have created a weather system. This first version changes cloud formations when the weather changes, and in future will support additional weather effects like dust, lighting, wind intensity and sandstorms.
[*] In-game interactions like opening doors and harvesting resources are now using a rebuilt interaction system which supports multiplayer.
[*] We have rebuilt our save system to support the fixed open world. Currently resources and locations will reset when you fly away and return to an area, but once we've added more content we will switch over to permanent saving - any changes you make to the world will be there forever.
[*] As a side effect of rebuilding our systems, several bugs no longer exist. Any existing problems with inventory or items are gone, as well as bugs like planted prickly pears not growing fruit or duplicate items appearing at workstations after loading a game.
[/list]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34741963/972d78b30e25816451de009fb41d944615b53c32.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34741963/972d78b30e25816451de009fb41d944615b53c32.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Multiplayer Update[/h2]
We are close to having multiplayer ready for testing. The initial multiplayer release will be a quiet one to find any major bugs or connectivity issues. Once we're sure everything is ready we will make an announcement for the proper release.

Desert Skies will use drop-in multiplayer so you will be able to invite friends to join your game at any time without needing to start a separate multiplayer game/mode. Initially multiplayer will be locally hosted with friends able to join your game via the Steam friends list, but later we will release a dedicated server.

notes.title: Early Access Update 1.15 - Caves
notes.notes:
This update brings caves to Desert Skies!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34741963/79f69d72a1e43ec72fc9f7b6f1b9d75f945133dc.png[/img]

Caves are a fun diversion from flying across the desert and are a great source of coal, iron, gold, sulfur and saltpeter. Keep an eye out for cracked walls while spelunking and hit them with a pickaxe to reveal secret tunnels!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34741963/38cfc74ad001b7e3165710d2ce508054994a041c.png[/img]

There are two unique caves in each biome (16 total). We developed new generation tools to help us create the caves and over time we will expand those tools with new tunnel types and more unique cave scenes so that we can make bigger and better caves. The cave generation tools will also serve as the basis for new location generation tools, to help us for example create a series of larger and more complex towns.

We're going to spend the next week researching what we need to complete cooperative multiplayer, then we'll post a timeline on our forum. We're also looking at switching to a fixed map - once we have a playable version we'll be seeking your feedback whether that's the best direction for Desert Skies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34741963/0c41c760d749ddd3fdbe84802a113324aa86749e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34741963/63c54fd36eb299a12b10b1ab58c64912fc3475fe.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34741963/bcef5ab101d826ba1f42af3a0405075ec7be0a3d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34741963/b09ce9db58e8f93939ddbf5e4a5c6acd8ee9b592.png[/img]

[h3]Full Patch Notes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Each biome has two caves to explore (look for the silver beacons).
[*] New drop flare item to help when exploring caves.
[*] Loot has been rebalanced in all locations.
[*] Mines on surface have been rebalanced across biomes.
[*] The old small points of interest have been removed in favour of mines, we will re-use them in future.
[*] Airship turning speed has been doubled.
[*] Fixed bug where loading save deep in gold mine could result in instant death.
[*] Fixed bug where already looted items could reappear after loading game.
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access Update 1.14.7 - Happy New Year!
notes.notes:
New Year celebrations have come to the desert!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34741963/b7552edb7ec2e12d3622494748bb9850bcec40b8.png[/img]

You can now find large buckets of fireworks in every location. You will be able to set them off immediately, or wait until midnight for a synchronised show.

Larger locations have more fireworks. We recommend Coalridge Station, Sunken Forest, Clifftop Cabin and Area 51 for the most impressive displays.

You don't have to be in the location to see the fireworks, they look great when flying past in your airship too!

[h3]Full Patch Notes[/h3]

[list]
[*] The Sleeping Bag and Bed now have the options to sleep until morning, evening or midnight.
[*] Fixed a rare save file bug where some apparatus would not load. This fix repairs the save file but you may lose a single apparatus (the one causing the bug).
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access Update 1.14.5 - Farming
notes.notes:
This update introduces farming to your airship! 

Harvest dirt with your shovel from new dirt mounds and build planting beds aboard your airship. With this update you can grow trees for wood and prickly pear cactuses for food and water.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34741963/7d32bbbce38f64edb8d24f3ab487f5794b9513cf.png[/img]

We will be adding the Kitchen and food buff system soon with a lot of other crops to grow as well, along with some decorative plants to brighten up your airship.

[h3]Full Patch Notes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Build the Tall Planting Bed on your airship. Plant a seed and add some water then watch your plants grow.
[*] Joshua Trees in the Oasis and the Abandoned Manor have a chance to drop seeds.
[*] Prickly Pear cactuses will sometimes have flowers which you can pick for seeds.
[*] Dirt mounds can be found in the desert and locations, harvest them with a shovel to gather dirt for your planting beds.
[*] Fertilizer can be found in locations, add it to a growing plant to speed up its growth.
[*] Fixed a save game bug where your game would stop saving after you had died a few times. This bug was really tricky, it was triggered by an issue with the coffins, thank you for the feedback which helped us to track it down!
[*] Fixed bug with sulfur mines having no sulfur sometimes.
[*] Added wells to more locations and increased food and water in the early game.
[*] The Still can now be filled with water from a canteen or bucket as well as waterskins.
[*] Fixed bug where dying with the build menu open would lock it on screen.
[*] Dropping nails, screws and bullets now drops a box instead of the small models.
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access Update 1.14 - Crafting
notes.notes:
[h3]New Airship Tiles![/h3]
There is a lot to build and craft in this update, starting with the first of our new airship designs! Your stylish new airship has doors, windows, trapdoors, ceilings, inner and outer walls and multiple variations for each tile.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34741963/94ca7c09117e1703aa3f1122f41b23acac4b6950.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34741963/321e9a6a8e95bcb2f09618a2ae3a4fb549e28487.gif[/img]

[h3]New Airship Apparatus![/h3]
Aboard your new airship you have lots of new and updated crafting apparatus to build. With the Helm you can turn your burner and engine on or off, set the direction you want to turn towards for easier control, and has a built in compass, wind pointer, burner fuel indicator and engine charge indicator!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34741963/686ab95a917026aaf5db3a17c78334d034da59cf.png[/img]

Here we have the new look Workbench and the new Artificer and Tesla Workbench apparatus.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34741963/e3ea6518d4c9530ffdb242eef06684329815a95c.png[/img]

Next up the new look Blacksmith and the new Gunsmith and Still apparatus.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34741963/f42b91ded40a325f2235ed905e224ef8604ca178.png[/img]

And the new look Smelter and Grill, and new Nail Rig and Grindstone apparatus.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34741963/7cd9d14ce1ce62525cbbf95fa17ab5ea4a105caa.png[/img]

We have created five new storage apparatus to display all of the new resources you'll be collecting in style. These containers display your resources out in the open, allowing you to assess your supplies at a glance while adding colour and flair to your airship!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34741963/576db2e41bb0b026496eb93ac164e5a07fc955c9.png[/img]

[h3]New Tools![/h3]
Craft new and updated tools with your new apparatus. Stone, Iron, Gold and Tesla axes and pickaxes each have different properties, and you can now wield the sickle, tap, shovel, flare gun, compass, pocket watch and spyglass! We've also updated the design on the knife, hammer, revolver and lantern.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34741963/0a488591c828c2fd6118fe0b0cb63374c5c60a22.png[/img]

[h3]New Resources[/h3]
To build and craft all of these new options you'll need to gather new resources from the desert, such as sulfur mines, agave and aloe vera plants, barrel cactuses, meteorites, and saltpeter, as well as the mysterious crystals and goo bulbs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34741963/600a99d2bc9ce15173a6b68f422e7632df4b91f6.png[/img]

From these resources you'll gather a lot of new and updated items to use in your crafting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34741963/41ff762c7eb1c117a3cc7a96e926f953c4c6bea5.png[/img]

We've also updated existing resources, mining is a new experience where you search for the weak point on a mine and crack it open with an explosive shower of rock to find the ores inside!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34741963/cb3ace298a232052d98798be9ee18fd23f50461e.gif[/img]

[h3]New Seeker Attack![/h3]
We've included the first of our planned changes to the Seeker experience in this update. If the Seeker gets close enough to you it will now grab you instead of melee attacking. If you have a knife in your inventory you'll be able to pass a skill check to fight off the Seeker's attack and escape without damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34741963/951c52301ef595083f9a671cbbb70db4c0c0aaa7.png[/img]

We look forward to seeing your new airship designs! With doors and trapdoors you can make all sorts of cool rooms and nooks for all of the new apparatus.

[h3]Roadmap[/h3]
We've posted a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1048950/discussions/0/2992043384047511025/]new roadmap[/url] to our forum that goes into much more detail about the rest of our plans with Desert Skies. Instead of large major updates we're going to be releasing smaller regular updates covering a variety of gameplay. You can also follow us on Twitter [url=https://twitter.com/desertskiesgame?lang=en]@DesertSkiesGame[/url] for details of each update as we're working on it.

[h3]Detailed Changelog[/h3]
[b]Airship[/b][list]
[*] New visual design with our first of the new tile sets - Rickety
[*] Taller walls with inner/outer wall support (so as we add new tile sets you can build adjacent rooms with different styles).
[*] New ceiling, door, window and trapdoor tiles.
[/list]
[b]Airship Apparatus[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated visual design for the workbench, grill, smelter and blacksmith.
[*] New apparatus: Helm. 
[*] New apparatus: Artificer. Craft devices like the compass, pocket watch, spyglass and more.
[*] New apparatus: Gunsmith. Craft guns and ammunition, including the new flare gun.
[*] New apparatus: Tesla Workbench. Craft advanced items and tools like the Tesla Axe and Pickaxe.
[*] New apparatus: Nail Rig. An automated nail crafter for producing lots of nails.
[*] New apparatus: Grindstone. Sharpen your iron and gold tools for faster harvesting.
[*] New storage apparatus: resource pallet, resource bucket, small resource bowl, powder basket and rope pole. Your resources are now stored out in the open so you can easily see how much you have, and add some colour and flair to your airship.
[/list]
[b]Tools[/b]
[list]
[*] Stone axe and pickaxe now break over time.
[*] Iron axe and pickaxe now harvest faster and can be sharpened at the Grindstone.
[*] New gold axe and pickaxe let you harvest new special resources, and can also be sharpened at the Grindstone.
[*] New Tesla axe and pickaxe for the ultimate harvesting speed.
[*] New flare gun for lighting up your surroundings.
[*] New sickle for harvesting agave and aloe vera, and more plants to come.
[*] New shovel for harvesting sand, sulfur and saltpeter, and more resources to come.
[*] New tap for harvesting water in the desert from barrel cactuses.
[*] New devices: spyglass, compass, and pocket watch.
[/list]
[b]Other Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] New location The Blacksmith, with new wobblehead.
[*] The Seeker now grabs you when it gets close instead of its previous melee attack. If you have a knife then you'll be able to escape the grab without taking damage if you pass a skill check.
[*] New resources to harvest from the desert: stone piles, barrel cactuses, agave, aloe vera, sulfur, saltpeter, meteorite, alien crystal and alien bulbs.
[*] Big performance improvements on large airships especially when taking off.
[*] Mining has changed, now you look for the weak point on a mine and use your pickaxe to bust it open and find the ores inside.
[*] All new tool animations with visible player hands.
[*] Building hammer is now a permanent item and no longer takes up an inventory slot.
[*] Trees and cactuses now leave behind a stump when harvested.
[*] Braziers on apparatus like the blacksmith produce charcoal for making gunpowder.
[*] You no longer have to restart if you die without a sleeping bag (to avoid new player frustration, we'll bring some ruthless survival elements back in as we balance the game with all the new content).
[*] Biomes rearranged with duplicate locations as placeholders for new locations being developed.
[*] New outline effect on interactive elements instead of the old glow.
[*] Locations now have titles when you enter them.
[*] Clocks in locations tell the time.
[*] Improved airship avoidance system to stop running into buttes.
[*] Loot rebalanced to be plentiful, will be balanced in future once new content stabilises.
[*] Music now plays the whole song instead of only 90 seconds.
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access Update 1.13.2 - Better Progression
notes.notes:
This update improves the progression system in the current game to be closer to our goal.

There are now 6 biomes with the locations spread out between them. The 4 new biomes are copies of an existing one with different colour schemes. We will replace these temporary versions with the real ones as we develop them. Keep an eye out for the title that appears as you fly into each biome for a hint about what it will eventually become!

We have also changed the beacon system. Locations you have not visited yet will now have a green beacon, while ones you have visited will still be gold. By visiting each of the locations in a biome you will unlock the next biome with a green beacon - so basically keep looking for green beacons to keep progressing forwards. Existing saves have had their beacons reset so it can drive you forwards into the new biomes.

We've also more than doubled the amount of desert you can see at a time, from 1 to 2.6 miles! To help you spot things in the new distance we've added a squint zoom - just hold down right mouse or left trigger to zoom in. In the crafting update we'll be adding a spyglass for even more zoom.

Other changes:
[list]
[*] Locations with essential items will not let you leave if you haven't looted the item.
[*] The Seeker now retreats if you stand on your airship for a short time.
[*] New graphics settings for Terrain Range, Content Range and Content Density. Lower them to improve your framerate or increase them for a larger denser desert.
[*] Added 3 new points of interest appearing in the new biomes.
[*] All locations now have campfires and lamps which you can activate to help you see at night.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34741963/1a18887be218c56f33f2f45c2ac49494f2ac4864.png[/img]

Check the forum for our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1048950/discussions/0/5188663423649914809/]Plans and Previews post[/url] about our next update - Crafting - and follow us on twitter [url=https://twitter.com/DesertSkiesGame]@DesertSkiesGame[/url] for dev updates about what we're working on next.

notes.title: Early Access Update 1.13.1 - Night Falls
notes.notes:
This update introduces a day and night cycle to Desert Skies!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34741963/c727c5f8bb8598fb16d30240cee2b40b162d8d46.png[/img]

Build lamps on your airship and carry a torch into locations to continue your journey when night falls.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34741963/34facc344644db1ed238243ebd20a7ae6c702fcc.png[/img]

Our [url=https://twitter.com/DesertSkiesGame]Twitter [/url]is now active! Follow us for regular dev updates as we develop each next update.

Read our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1048950/discussions/0/3880365909902953096/]forum post[/url] for more details about the day and night cycle and bug fixes in this update.

notes.title: Early Access Update 1.13 - A New World
notes.notes:
Update 1.13 replaces the existing world generation system to create a larger and more interesting world, with biomes and more to explore.

[h3]Control your airship![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34741963/2731c5611b548b4881c1613733cc61329908c40c.png[/img]
Build the propeller engine aboard your airship and take control of your journey! The winds won't always be in your favour, build a weather vane or observe wind trails in the sky to navigate your airship.

[h3]Biomes![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34741963/41b73db1a83298f6eafd31548ce6ec221cd64385.png[/img]
This update introduces our first two biomes! Your journey now begins in the iconic Monument Valley before moving into an improved version of the Desert Skies classic desert.

[h3]New Core World System![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34741963/8a7e6ccaf5ea4fa3e395c09ae6677cb0517e5c59.png[/img]
Explore a more interesting world with location phases and points of interest in the desert.

With this major upgrade complete we can take Desert Skies to new heights. We're calling this next phase of development the countdown to Early Access 2.0. We will be releasing a series of regular patches which add new content or enhance an aspect of core gameplay, starting with a patch in around a week which will introduce a day and night cycle.

Read our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1048950/discussions/0/2573194192011803862/]forum post[/url] for more details about the future of Desert Skies.

notes.title: Desert Skies Christmas Event is here!
notes.notes:
Merry Christmas from White Rabbit Games!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34741963/e2b784fab55f8572f4b30b249310632a85d3e874.png[/img]

This peaceful event will let you transform the desert into a winter wonderland and deliver presents for Santa to earn new decorations for your airship.

Keep an eye out for Santa's sleigh in the desert to get started.

In the main menu Settings you can now choose which event you would like to enable - Christmas, Halloween or the normal game.

We hope you all have a Happy New Year!

notes.title: Halloween Event Phase III
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34741963/fd66bea58a9466e2033021dce8333d6e12388a5c.png[/img]

In the third phase of the Halloween event you will do battle with the boss of the nightmare realm. Look for the new ammo pickups to reload your righteous revolver, beat the boss and win a new decoration for your airship!

We'll keep the event up as long as we can to give you a chance to play phase 3, probably until late next week.

notes.title: Halloween Event Phase II
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34741963/b480699160c87c3ffcaaafff29d945de0d22535e.png[/img]

In the second phase of the event some of the ghosts will try to drive you from their realm before you can find the golden jack-o'-lantern and escape. Wield a righteous revolver in the nightmare and banish them instead!

Stay tuned for phase III in a few days!

[h1]Halloween Event Phase II[/h1][list][*] Some ghosts only watch you, but others now suddenly attack.
[*] You now carry a righteous revolver into the nightmare realm.
[*] The Legion camp now has a Trick or Treat stand.
[*] More treats have been added as rewards.
[/list]
[h1]Halloween Tweaks[/h1][list][*] Your health drops from the mist significantly more slowly.
[*] There is now an instruction scroll on each Trick or Treat stand.
[*] A specific ambient sound starts playing and getting louder as you get closer to the escape jack-o'-lantern.
[/list]
[h1]General Tweaks[/h1][list][*] The status bars on the top left of your screen now flash whenever they go down (such as when you lose health), and continually flashes when close to 0.
[*] An ammo counter now displays when you have the revolver equipped.
[*] Decorations like wobbleheads, ship bottles and jack-o'-lanterns can now be placed on platforms instead of just on tables and shelves.
[*] Once you are in the endless desert a location can now only repeat after at least 8 other locations have appeared.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34741963/6ca62eb8d7ddf1efbb47280ce459b76b459242ea.png[/img]

notes.title: Desert Skies Halloween Event
notes.notes:
It's here - our Desert Skies Halloween event starts today! Jump in game and give it a try!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34741963/8c03fcbdf4b33f62122c14b037629b2eb3f184df.png[/img]

Mysterious trick or treat stands have appeared in several locations. Find and interact with them for your treat... or trick!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34741963/98d0e9338dd12dcebab26fe4d31d5d21f1b80958.png[/img]

In this first phase of the event you will venture into a spooky realm and explore twisted copies of the locations you know as you search for a way out. You can't breathe in there, and the exit changes position each time you enter a nightmare, so you'll need to be fast! Luckily there are ways to buy yourself more time to escape.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34741963/2ac070bfb90e5f6db5fb602a50804ffca2e5432e.png[/img]

Your entrance into the spooky realm won't go unnoticed... In a few days phase two will start and the nightmare will become a more dangerous place, with a new threat but also new treats to collect.

The Halloween event is also giving us the opportunity to test out some upcoming new features, you can [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1048950/discussions/0/1644304412667060995/]read more about it here[/url].

notes.title: Early Access Update 1.10.2
notes.notes:
You can now play Desert Skies with your favourite controller! Let us know how your model of controller works and what you think of our default bindings. We already know we need to add some aim assist! We have a new input system to support controllers, with some UI changes and control changes, so let us know if you have any issues.

This update is the first of some bigger behind the scenes changes. The launcher is gone and there's now an in-game menu with new graphics and keybinding settings. Lower end PCs get significantly better performance, especially with the Very Low graphics setting, but even high end PCs should notice gains as well. Please let us know if you experience any graphics problems.

Finally, Desert Skies will be having a Halloween event! Stay tuned in the coming days for more details and the event's launch!

notes.title: Early Access 1.10 - New location, decorations and things to build, plus torches
notes.notes:
This update adds a new location with a new wobblehead and some new pieces to the story. We've also added lighting to the game with torches and lanterns, added some paintings to decorate your airship with, and added a way to respawn without losing your items.

This update has been a slow one while we’ve been experimenting for our next major update, now we're full speed ahead again. Check out [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1048950/discussions/0/1639794651173233871/]our roadmap[/url] for details on the changes to come!

[h1]New Location - [Redacted][/h1]
This secret facility in the desert was built to study the creatures by an enigmatic inventor and scientist. Above ground they've been experimenting with airships. Below ground....

In this location you will find loot, story elements, a schematic for something new to build, and a new wobblehead!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34741963/8516767a20beacc614c965942b0d55e6a7a78577.jpg[/img]

[h1]Lights[/h1]
You can craft a torch at the workbench and a lantern at the blacksmith. Equip them to light up the area around you. They will come in handy because caves are now quite dark!
You can also find a lamp in your build menu for lighting up your airship.
With working lights we're one step closer to having a day and night cycle!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34741963/3b18e4725b475cfd684260b2bbb43d2b4b085cea.jpg[/img]

[h1]Paintings[/h1]
We've added a new type of decoration for your airship to be found in the world - paintings! These paintings will show up in some locations and can be collected to place on your airship. The paintings are real pieces from famous artists of the Western era.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34741963/8eac7d9010f6858b52d7cc8e9f811e1aeb3f3e4b.jpg[/img]

[h1]Bed & Bedside Table[/h1]
Sick of collecting your coffin? A bed can now be built on your airship to replace the sleeping bag. With a bed you'll keep all your items after dying! To go with your bed you can also build a bedside table for decorations and a little bit of storage.
You need to find the schematic for the bed in the new location before you can build it.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34741963/fbc528ed02944aca3935676bd20654e73b3f6c60.jpg[/img]

[h1]Tweaks[/h1]
[list]
[*] When respawning on a sleeping bag you'll keep a hammer and 2 pieces of wood in your inventory, so that you can survive even if you lose your coffin.
[*] You can now choose between 4 different crosshairs from the in-game settings menu, including some larger ones. We'll add more options in the future.
[*] We've lowered the mountain at the Old Coot's place so you no longer get stuck on it.
[*] Fixed bug where dropping items in a stack then picking one up could make the others disappear. [/list]

notes.title: Early Access 1.9 - New location, new NPC, quests, collectables, new buildables, and more!
notes.notes:
This big update brings a new location, a new NPC with quests to complete and a cool reward, a new danger in the gold cave, a series of collectables, a water barrel and water tank for storing water on your airship, carrying water in buckets, new buildable furniture, and fixes and tweaks!

[h1]New Location - Clifftop Cabin[/h1]
Follow the winding path up to the clifftops where a crazy Old Coot has built himself a cabin safe from the Seekers below. While doing some chores for the Old Coot you will explore the clifftops, journey through the looming arches to find the pond hidden amongst the buttes, and look for the cave which houses a [b]mysterio[/b]us surprise.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34741963/bd74d0c8ce4bf8284710f8df2f0e601bcd3d0b6c.jpg[/img]

[h1]New NPC with quests![/h1]
With the Old Coot we introduce quests to Desert Skies! He has a series of four quests for you to complete and something extra special for your airship as a reward. Let us know what you think, do you want to see more quests on your journey?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34741963/f47df7dc1bf57fa44280f198570f7e0b3711104d.jpg[/img]

[h1]Collectable wobbleheads![/h1]
What is a wobblehead? It's a cool little figurine for decorating your airship, and when you take off its head wobbles! There are 13 to collect, one hidden in each location after the start.

We have been extra devious in hiding the wobbleheads and they don't get highlighted as you enter a location, so you're going to have to keep your eyes peeled and search high and low to find them (hint hint).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34741963/dce5eb878a9f5ba2996f00302977940dcf450846.png[/img]

[h1]More furniture[/h1]
With 13 wobbleheads you'll need somewhere to place them! We've added two new types of tables, a new type of shelf, and a wall mounted cabinet to your building menu.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34741963/feedfbbf745655dc47a623b1ba78fd62efa4ad33.jpg[/img]

[h1]Water[/h1]
You can now build a Water Barrel and a Water Tank on your airship. The barrel holds 3 canteens worth of water, while the tank holds 7! You'll need a way to fill them up, so you can now equip the bucket. Be careful though, if you sprint, jump, fall or unequip the bucket then you'll spill its precious water. Carefully carry it back to your airship!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34741963/b5fed5117f2ec23716398578b52a8a5a5e2a7403.jpg[/img]

[h1]Danger in the Gold Cave[/h1]
Despite it's eeriness the gold cave has always been a safe location, until now! The danger doesn't come from the Seeker however... Tread carefully and keep your ears pricked!

[h1]Tweaks[/h1]
We've made a number of fixes and tweaks based on feedback. Thank you for getting in touch!
[list]
[*] We've changed the hit detection on the Seeker's heart shard, it should be more accurate for all players now.
[*] We've improved the feature where holding down the interact button keeps harvesting/shooting/etc, you won't have that issue where it harvests/shoots an extra time anymore.
[*] Dropping an item on your sleeping bag, or anything else aboard the airship, no longer stops your flight.
[*] When you continue a game you always start descending now, so that you don't fly over a location before you have time to stop.
[*] Fixed the always locked doors in the showdown location.
[*] We've added more loot to the showdown location.
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access 1.8 - Seeker Upgrade
notes.notes:
This update overhauls the Seeker with a lot of changes!

Our goal was to make hiding from the Seeker as it hunts you a more engaging cat-and-mouse experience, and to make combat with the Seeker more difficult (once you have the weaponry necessary to defeat it).

Check out [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1048950/discussions/0/1643167006266629581/]our post in our Steam forum[/url] with full details of what has changed, and please let us know what you think of the Seeker now!

We will tweak the Seeker further based on feedback in the next few patches, and in the longer term we have additional changes planned including different types of Seekers with new combat abilities.

[h1]Upcoming[/h1]
This was a long patch focused on upgrading our enemy code for the Seeker and future enemies. Now we're going to work on a number of smaller and more frequent updates with new content, new gameplay and bug fixes.

[h1]Other Changes This Patch[/h1]
- As part of the Seeker changes you now have a stamina bar limiting your sprinting when the Seeker has spawned. When there's no Seeker you still have unlimited sprinting.
- Overhauled the showdown location.
- Hard Mode - items are no longer highlighted when entering location.
- Temporarily removed fullscreen/resolution/vsync settings from in-game menu as they have been causing issues for some players. We will return these settings ASAP once we figure out what wasn't working properly.
- Press F11 to hide/show the HUD (for taking screenshots).
- You can now hold down the interact key (default left mouse) instead of needing to keep pressing it (useful for harvesting and shooting).
- Fixed labels on left/right movement keys in Input tab in launcher.
- You can jump over the hedge in the restaurant location now.
- Fixed Seeker spawn points in upgraded locations from previous patch.
- Fixed bug that resulted in too many cactus fruits spawning in locations.
- Fixed bug that allowed decorations to spawn in containers at locations - decorations should only appear as items within a location.
- Fixed music setting not turning music off when selected.

notes.title: Early Access 1.7.1
notes.notes:
We finished some new cosmetic options for your airship and couldn't wait for the next patch to include them, so here they are!

In your build menu you'll find two new types of airship building blocks: lattices and leaves. These platforms, walls and ramps add a touch of class to your airship and brighten it up with more light and a bit of colour.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34741963/f5db5a048da4145588c4eb04151e455bc7aefe1a.png[/img]

You'll also see a new option on the build menu for furniture. We're starting you off with two types of table and a shelf, the beginning of the options we'll be adding in coming patches.

What use are tables and shelves without something to put on them? Hidden in a few locations you can now find two new decorations - a ship in a bottle and a stuffed parrot.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34741963/a646724b93383dae51346a63c72dc1ad6a97528b.png[/img]

notes.title: Early Access 1.7
notes.notes:
For this update we have overhauled many existing locations to make them bigger and more interesting, with more story elements!

Here's a sneak peak at one changed location:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34741963/21d23c3f38912896f939412c074f6734506fa4d0.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34741963/49ebeca3e7126e0e97eccb2d66789a1d62c597c7.png[/img]

In changing the layout of these locations we have created different arrangements of obstacles. This lays the groundwork for our next patch, which will improve the Seeker experience.

We want to make fighting the Seeker (once you can kill it) more challenging, through improving the Seeker's AI and making use of the new location layouts.

In doing so we don't want to make it harder for new players in the early game though, instead we're aiming for a more exciting cat-and-mouse experience as you try to avoid the Seeker while looting the location.

After the big content update of this patch we also want to work on a lot of smaller improvements such as loot rebalancing, new things to craft, something new to harvest with a new tool, some new things in the desert between locations, and more NPCs.

notes.title: Early Access 1.6.2
notes.notes:
More bug fixes! We're now turning our attention back to new content for the next patch, unless any critical issues pop up of course.
[list]
[*] We have rewritten the deconstruction system to be much more robust, this should eliminate any remaining issues with deconstructing platforms.
[*] The airship no longer takes off automatically when you input fuel.
[*] We've attempted another fix for the rotated camera issue that happens randomly to some people sometimes when they die and respawn.
[*] The Seeker will no longer chase you into Hermit Oasis.
[*] Dropping items while flying on the airship no longer stops its movement.
[*] Fixed sky turning black if you die inside cave and respawn.
[*] Seeker corpse no longer blocks movement so you can't get trapped by it.
[*] Fixed blacksmith sound not being positional.
[*] Fixed crates on train platform that could trap you if you jumped in between them.
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access 1.6.1
notes.notes:
This patch adds more in-game settings and fixes a number of issues. We're still working through more fixes and tweaks from feedback, as well as working on the loot and Seeker balancing. We have also improved the logging we capture for the Feedback form to help us identify and resolve some of the bugs that have been tricky to replicate.

[h1]New Settings[/h1]
These new settings are available in the settings menu. The screen settings will override your resolution/window choice made in the launcher. We will remove the launcher entirely once we have moved all settings into the game menu.
[list]
[*] Screen mode (exclusive fullscreen, borderless fullscreen, window)
[*] Resolution and refresh rate
[*] Vertical sync (exclusive fullscreen only)
[*] Mouse sensitivity
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] When you land in the desert the Seeker now follows the same noise system as in locations.
[*] Pressing escape now closes the current menu.
[*] Players who were unable to deconstruct their platforms on saved airships should be able to do so now (if not please send feedback).
[*] Nails are easier to see in locations.
[*] Fixed bug where canteens and revolvers placed in containers would lose their water/bullets on save/load.
[*] Fixed bug where non-stop jumping would prevent Seeker from hearing your movement noise.
[*] Fixed another bug that could have your airship slide along the ground or fly off without you.
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access 1.6
notes.notes:
Early Access 1.6 brings TWO new locations, including our first oasis, and a surprise - our first NPC!

[h1]The Hermit Oasis[/h1]
This oasis is home to a friendly hermit who would love some company. Drink the water, eat fresh fish, and enjoy some peace and quiet. You can take a break and work on your airship without fear of the Seeker hunting you.

[h1]Restaurant[/h1]
No reservation is required at this fine dining establishment since the critchers ran everyone out of town. Come along and see what was left behind, just make sure your don't end up on the menu!

[h1]New Seeker System Change[/h1]
We've hidden the Seeker noise bar, as we felt it removed the tension of not knowing how close you were to the seeker's arrival. It's still the same system behind the scenes with the noise you making bringing the Seeker ever closer, now you just won't know how close it is until the rumble begins.

[h1]Next Patch - Bugs and Improvements[/h1]
We're going to spend some time focusing on bugs and quality of life improvements, including rebalancing loot and Seeker difficulty. We've got a list of issues and suggestions from the feedback you all have sent in that we're going to work through, thank you so much!

notes.title: Early Access 1.5
notes.notes:
[h1]New Seeker Spawn System[/h1]
Today's update overhauls the Seeker spawn system, we think it's a lot more engaging now!

When you approach a location a noise bar will now appear on the left under the fuel bar. This represents how aware the Seeker is that prey (you) is running around the desert. The noise you make while exploring a location will be sensed by the Seeker and the bar will increase until it fills up and the Seeker arrives!

The new system will give you some control over whether and when the Seeker will arrive at a location. Play around and you'll figure out the rules - one hint we'll give you is that your footsteps are only sensed when on the sand.

We don't want the new system to take away the surprise and panic of the Seeker's arrival though, so we've added a few new noise-making elements. Watch out for random patches of gravel while you explore, and be aware that the worn wooden doors of the West can sometimes open with a bang!

This is a brand new system and it's going to need some balancing. Please let us know whether you think some things add too much noise to the bar - or too little. Once we've got a good balance we'll soon start adding other noise-making elements to the locations to keep you on your toes while you explore.

[h1]Deconstructing Platforms![/h1]
We've received quite a few feedbacks requesting this so we got it in this patch. You can deconstruct platforms and descenders so long as they're not supporting other structures or work stations.

[h1]Other Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] We added more anvils to the early game and a bit more obvious (I don't know why the blacksmith took his anvil to the outhouse!). We're thinking about how we can ensure people don't miss those key early game items without having other players end up with 4 anvils in their inventory.
[*] Fixed a rare save game bug where if you saved at the right (wrong?) moment the game wouldn't load.
[*] Fixed the issue where if you killed the Seeker shortly before the showdown location then it wouldn't spawn there and so the doors wouldn't open, trapping you inside.
[*] Crafting stations now show if they will produce more than one item (eg "Craft 5 Nails").
[/list]

[h1]Next Patch[/h1]
The next patch will bring our first oasis location, and with it a cool surprise. At an oasis you'll be able to take a break without fear of the Seeker arriving to chase you away.

[h1]Feedback[/h1]
We've been overwhelmed by the amount of feedback sent to us, thank you! Be assured that we read it all and add so many items to our todo list based on it. We'll reply as we can over the coming days.

notes.title: Roadmap and Hotfix EA.1.4.1
notes.notes:
We have updated with a hotfix that addresses a number of bugs we've received via feedback. We know there are more bugs to fix, and we will keep working on them for future patches.

We also wanted to talk a bit about our roadmap for Desert Skies in the near future. In addition to the reworked seeker spawn system for the next patch, we're also working on a number of new features including;

[list]
[*] More locations for the first zone.
[*] Oasis locations, where you can take a break and work on your airship without fear of the seeker's arrival.
[*] More story elements in current and new locations.
[*] Random elements to locations, such as different buildings in towns, to add variety to playthroughs.
[*] More engaging location exploration through interactive elements, such as locked doors with hidden keys, or hidden treasures and triggered traps.
[*] New tools, such as a shovel with dirt mounds to dig, and a dowsing rod to help find items.
[*] New work stations, like a grindstone to sharpen your tools for improved performance, and a water barrel to store water aboard your airship.
[*] Some fun interactive things to do while flying on your airship between locations.
[*] More decorations for your airship.
[*] And a few more features we want to keep under wraps to surprise you with.
[/list]

In the longer term we'll also be adding the second zone, with a new desert and all new desert elements, the next part of the story, and different enemies to fight in different ways. We'll also be adding an engine and propeller, to let you control your airships direction, and to provide an engaging maintenance mechanic during flight.

We haven't planned it out in detail yet, but we'd also like to add airship damage with flying critchers and even bandit airships. We'd love to have airship verse airship fights where you use cannons or the gattling gun to shoot the bandits down to the ground and then loot their crashed airship.

We're brimming with ideas for Desert Skies, some planned out in detail for the near term and others dreams for the long term. We want to keep our minds open and to constantly work on making our game more fun and engaging in any way we can. If there's anything you'd love to see in the game then please let us know!

notes.title: Early Access 1.4
notes.notes:
This update allows you to deconstruct parts of your airship and get their ingredients back! If you want to redecorate your airship then check out the new option in the build menu.

We've slowed down the seeker's arrival early game to give you more time to explore and loot, and we've made ingot molds easier to find. There are also a few new decorations to find in locations, to make your airship feel cozier.

Next patch is going to rework the system that controls seeker spawning, we think the new system will be much more engaging. We are also going to spend some time fixing bugs that were reported through the feedback form - thank you for letting us know about them!

notes.title: Early Access 1.3
notes.notes:
Our first new locations arrives with this update. Whether starting a new game or continuing in the endless desert you will soon discover it.

We also introduce decorations you can place on the walls of your airship. One can be found in a few locations, while the other is a reward for defeating the seeker. More decorations will follow in coming patches.

We have fixed up some issues with the showdown outpost. If you die you'll now have time to regain your loot before the seeker respawns, and if you don't have the means of defeating the seeker you'll now have a way of escaping the outpost.

Next update we will be adding the ability to deconstruct parts on your airship!

notes.title: Early Access 1.2
notes.notes:
This update allows you to continue playing after reaching the current end of the Early Access story.

In the infinite desert locations will appear at random and all resources will be available for harvesting. You can survive, explore and expand your airship to your heart's content. The seeker will continue to hunt you (except in Exploration Mode), but now if you defeat it then you will be safe for a while until a new one arrives.

Our next update will add a new location into the mix, and some collectable decorations you can add to your airship!

notes.title: Early Access 1.1
notes.notes:
We've just uploaded our first patch!

This update adds an Exploration Mode for those of you who'd like to explore the game without the seeker hunting you, a new cactus to the desert with edible fruit that restores some hunger and thirst, and fixes a few bugs.

Happy flying!

notes.title: Desert Skies Released!
notes.notes:
Welcome to Desert Skies Early Access!

We are excited to release our game to the world and begin building a community of players!

We have been hard at work the past nine months getting to this point, but this is the true beginning of the Desert Skies journey. We have a huge roadmap planned with lots of awesome gameplay to come, including more locations, more things to build and craft, and new deserts with different enemies and different combat gameplay. Right now though we're eager to get your feedback and hear your ideas!

We believe that a great survival game comes from its developers listening to their players. We've already made several big changes in response to our small beta and have more on the way. We have put a feedback form right into the game, you can access it from the menu or by pressing F1 at any time. Please send us your thoughts, any bugs you find, or anything at all!

Our number one priority this launch week is responding to any issues you have. If anything major pops up then we will hotfix it as quickly as possible, but even after that we plan on updating Desert Skies every 1-2 weeks with balance tweaks, bug fixes, and new content as fast as we can create it.

We're proud of the foundation we have built, and we hope you enjoy the world we have created. We are excited about what is to come and can't wait to entertain and surprise you with ever-improving journeys through the Desert Skies.

White Rabbit Games
